veranderings.blok: Watter plant, watter deel, watter plek
veranderings.voor: van sy eie streek by die naam
veranderings.na: van sy eie streek by naam
veranderings.rede: The fixed expression is 'iemand of iets by naam ken'; the article makes it read less idiomatically.
The subject is two kinds of knowledge, which cannot 'look at' anything; 'gaan oor' says the same thing more naturally.
